name: A-29B Super Tucano (Community)
summary: Free open-source A-29B Super Tucano turboprop light-attack aircraft module for DCS World.
description: Independent community A-29B with FLIR, CCIP and its own systems; the README says it needs no other modules. Installs like other aircraft mods into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\aircraft`.

releases.changelog: Minor updates for compatibility with DCS 2.9.26.23303.
